parsed.summary: The proposed patch removes caching and inlines the evaluation of skipif/xfail conditions. This should resolve the issue of incorrect caching based on item globals.

issues.description: The patch removes caching without considering potential performance implications. Caching was likely introduced to improve performance, and removing it without a performance benchmark could lead to regressions.
The patch introduces an import statement for `_pytest._code` which is not consistent with the existing style of the codebase. It would be better to import this at the top of the file.
